_comment: Curated sound, particle-effect and font sources for the asset dataset. Used by harness/media.py (buildoff assets media). CC0 is preferred; CC-BY items are kept only where nothing CC0 fits, and media.py writes their credits into the folder's ATTRIBUTION.md. Every file's sha256 lands in the item's info.json.

car-engine-loops.author: domasx2
car-engine-loops.what: engine loops from idle (loop_0) to high revs (loop_5); crossfade by speed

tire-squeal-loop.author: qubodup
tire-squeal-loop.what: looping tire squeal for skids and hard turns

alarm.author: Frenchyboy
alarm.what: building alarm bell for when the heist is noticed

footsteps.author: congusbongus
footsteps.license_note: Each surface folder keeps its license.txt naming the Freesound recording it was derived from; gravel is CC0, the rest CC-BY-3.0.
footsteps.what: footstep sets per surface: boots on concrete, grass, gravel, metal, tile, wood

impact-sounds.what: 130 impacts: punches, metal, glass, wood, footsteps on several surfaces

interface-sounds.what: 100 UI sounds: clicks, confirms, errors, pickups, menu ticks

particle-pack.what: 80 transparent particle sprites (plus pre-rotated copies in Rotated/): smoke, fire, sparks, flares, stars, dirt, muzzle flashes

bebasneue.what: tall condensed caps for titles, mission names, WANTED banners

anton.what: heavy condensed display face for big on-screen callouts

rajdhani.what: squared techy sans for the HUD, money and minimap labels

sharetechmono.what: monospace for terminals, hacking screens and phone texts
